title: Rosalind and the Machine
author: Dominic Halloran
blurb: Quentin Okonkwo, a terraformer tending a garden meant for people not yet born, records the slow death of a colony everyone else forgot. Then an unfamiliar name shows up on the manifest of a ship that never flew — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must keep a lie alive that holds two fleets apart before the fleet's truce expires.
style: vivid, cinematic prose with tight pacing
